scheme_name: Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh / Direct Benefits Transfer For LPG
other_conditions: Applicant must be an LPG user.
Combined taxable income of the applicant and their spouse must not exceed ₹10,00,000 in the previous financial year.
Aadhaar number must be linked to the applicant’s bank account and LPG consumer number within three months, otherwise the subsidy will not be available.
benefits_summary: Direct transfer of LPG subsidy to the consumer’s bank account, ensuring timely and transparent delivery.
